Q: Thank you for agreeing to give a recorded statement today. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my name on the recording, if that's okay. I can answer the questions aobut the accident.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the collision happened?
A: It was on a main road in League City, Texas, at a stoplight near a shopping center. I was stopped behind another
vehicle waiting for the light to change.
Q: What happened next?
A: I was stopped, and then I felt a hard jolt from behind. The car behind me hit mine. I didn't see it coming in the
mirror in time.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was.
Q: Did you hit your head or lose consciousness?
A: No, I didn't hit my head and I didn't black out. My head snapped back and forward, though.
Q: When did you first notice pain or stiffness?
A: The next morning my neck was really stiff and I had a headache. By the second day it was hard to turn my head to
check my blind spot when driving.
Q: Have you seen a doctor since the accident?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care that same afternoon and then made an appointment with my family doctor. They
diagnosed me with whiplash and gave me a neck brace and some physical therapy referrals.
Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?
A: Yes. I still get stiffness and some pain at the end of the day, and I've had to cut back on lifting at work for now.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm following my doctor's advice and I'm trying to get back to normal as quickly as I can.
Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page

- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),

- "reason": one short sentence.
